title: `managedNamespaceMetadata` no longer preserves client-side-applied namespace labels/annotations

detection.reason: presence of spec.syncPolicy.managedNamespaceMetadata on the Application, as the agent projects it

quote: This change affects the `managedNamespaceMetadata` field of the `Application` CRD. Previously, labels and annotations applied via a client-side apply would be preserved when `managedNamespaceMetadata` was enabled. Now, those existing labels and annotation will be removed.
remediation: For every Application that sets `managedNamespaceMetadata`, migrate the target namespace's labels and annotations from client-side to server-side apply (the kubectl resource-upgrade guide) before upgrading, or declare them in `managedNamespaceMetadata` itself — otherwise the next sync strips them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applications -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.syncPolicy.managedNamespaceMetadata != null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name + " -> " + .spec.destination.namespace' # Applications printed manage their namespace metadata — check the namespace for client-side-applied labels

title: `argocd-redis` NetworkPolicy loses its Egress restrictions from 2.10.11

detection.reason: fires when the stock redis/haproxy NetworkPolicy exists — its Egress section is what the 2.10.11 manifests open up

quote: Starting with Argo CD 2.10.11, the NetworkPolicy for the `argocd-redis` and `argocd-redis-ha-haproxy` dropped Egress restrictions. This change was made to allow access to the Kubernetes API to create a secret to secure Redis access.
remediation: If your policy required Redis to be egress-locked, add back an Egress rule that allows the Kubernetes API plus the traffic Redis itself needs (the note's example), instead of the unrestricted egress the new manifests ship.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get networkpolicy -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("redis")) | .metadata.name + ": egress=" + (.spec.egress | tostring | .[0:120])' # a redis policy printed with egress=null or [] restricts nothing after the upgrade
